## 更新内容 | What's Changed

### 剪贴板自动推送 | Automatic Clipboard Push

- 剪贴板模块新增 "自动推送到手机" 开关, 也可在设置 > 通用中开启; 开启后电脑上新复制的文本会自动写入当前选中的手机, 开启时剪贴板里已有的内容不会推送. 默认关闭. (#10)
  The Clipboard module adds a Push to phone automatically switch, also available in Settings > General. When on, text newly copied on the computer is written to the selected phone; whatever is already on the clipboard when you turn it on is not pushed. Off by default. (#10)

- 模块内的状态行显示正在监听, 最近一次推送时间, 等待设备在线或手机锁屏等原因, 不会弹出提示; 非文本内容和超过 256 KiB 的文本不推送, 重复复制同一段文本也不会重复推送.
  A status line in the module shows whether it is watching, when text was last pushed, or why nothing was pushed (device offline, phone locked, and so on) without showing toasts. Non-text content and text over 256 KiB are skipped, and copying the same text again does not push it twice.

- 开启后, 密码等敏感内容同样会被推送到手机, 请按需开启.
  While it is on, passwords and other sensitive text you copy are pushed to the phone as well, so turn it on only when you need it.

### 投屏 | Screen Mirroring

- 工具页新增投屏模块, 调用电脑上已安装的 scrcpy (2.0 及以上) 为选中的设备投屏; 每台设备同时保留一个投屏窗口, 窗口关闭, 设备断开或启动失败时显示对应原因. (#10)
  A new Mirroring module on the Tools page mirrors the selected device with the scrcpy (2.0 or later) installed on your computer. Each device keeps one mirroring window at a time, and the module shows why a session ended: window closed, device disconnected, or a failed start. (#10)

- 可选标准, 省流, 高清三档画质, 以及息屏投屏, 保持唤醒, 显示触摸, 窗口置顶, 关闭音频, 仅查看六个选项; 仅查看时不会传入息屏投屏, 保持唤醒和显示触摸.
  Choose Standard, Data saver, or HD quality, plus six options: Screen off, Stay awake, Show touches, Always on top, No audio, and View only. View only does not send Screen off, Stay awake, or Show touches.

- 设置新增投屏分区: 自动在 PATH 和常见安装位置查找 scrcpy, 也可以手动选择可执行文件; 可以追加额外的 scrcpy 参数, 但不能通过参数改投其他设备.
  A new Mirroring section in Settings finds scrcpy on PATH and in common install locations, or lets you choose the executable yourself. You can append extra scrcpy arguments, but they cannot switch mirroring to another device.

- 关闭应用时会一并结束正在运行的投屏.
  Quitting the app also ends any mirroring sessions that are still running.

### 体验与修复 | Experience and Fixes

- 修复 Android 17 设备上剪贴板推送和读取不可用的问题.
  Fixed pushing text to and copying text from the clipboard on Android 17 devices.

- 修复 macOS 上用鼠标打开文件页的收藏夹或收藏编辑后, 方向键和 Tab 键无法进入弹出层的问题.
  Fixed arrow keys and Tab not reaching the Files bookmarks list or bookmark editor on macOS after opening them with the mouse.

- 修复 macOS 上在工具页拖选文字时整个界面向上偏移的问题.
  Fixed the whole window content shifting up on macOS when drag-selecting text on the Tools page.

### 平台说明 | Platform Notes

- 本版新功能已在 macOS 和 Windows 上用真机验证, Linux 版未做原生运行验证: 投屏在 Linux 上未经实测; 剪贴板自动推送在 Linux 上暂不支持, 开关为禁用状态.
  The new features in this release were verified with real devices on macOS and Windows; the Linux build has not been tested natively. Mirroring is untested on Linux, and automatic clipboard push is not supported there (the switch is disabled).
